binders: Universally quantify over a finite type D with decidable equality, an arbitrary type FacePoint with a measurable-space structure, and a natural number m. Write V=R^{Fin m}, equipped with componentwise vector operations and norm ||v||∞=max_{i<m}|v_i|.
Given m>0 and |D|>0, universally quantify over a family F of the structure described below and a proof of its quality property Q.
Universally quantify over a level ℓ∈N, direction sequence d:N→D, duration sequence τ:N→R, ghost field g:N→D→Line_ℓ→Z→V, initial state U⁰:Cell_ℓ→V, and number of steps S∈N.
For each direction e, the schedule witness k may depend on e and must satisfy k<S and d_k=e.

Within the accuracy conclusion, universally quantify over e∈D, q:R^D→R→V, p∈R, any certificate for (F,e,q,p), n above its threshold, a duration t∈(0,H], boundary data b, current state u, real numbers A,E,G, and a cell.

Within the accumulated-error conclusion, universally quantify over physical fields q_k:R^D→R→V, real sequences a_k,l_k,s_k, a real initial bound B₀, and real bounds η_k(c), followed by all k≤S and cells.
Within the Cartesian conclusion, universally quantify over an axis grid in every direction, cell positions Cell_ℓ→Z^D, directional face positions D→Face_ℓ→Z^D, and fluxes f_e:V→V.
hypotheses: The family has quality Q: for every level n, direction e, ghost field b and current state u, if every u(c) lies in States_e and every b(e,L,j) with lookup(e,L,j)=none lies in States_e, there exists t∈(0,H] for which the ghost-modified method admits u in direction e. This t may depend on n,e,b,u.

Quality Q also requires: for each direction e there exists a real p_e>1 such that every smooth reference q in that direction has a nonempty accuracy-certificate type of order p_e. The order is chosen before q; the certificate and its constant and threshold may depend on q.

Quality Q additionally requires: for each direction e there exist K_e≥0 and a sequence ε_e(n)≥0 tending to zero as n→∞ such that, for every level n, ghost field b, current state u, admitted t∈(0,H], and line L, Var(n,e,L,b,T_{n,b,e,t}u)≤(1+K_e t)Var(n,e,L,b,u)+t ε_e(n). K_e and ε_e are chosen before n,b,u,t,L.
Every direction occurs among the first S scheduled directions: ∀e∈D, ∃k∈N, k<S and d_k=e.
The given trajectory is valid: for every k<S, 0<τ_k≤H and the method at level ℓ with ghosts g_k admits U_k in direction d_k for duration τ_k.
conclusions: The conclusion is the conjunction m>0 ∧ (|D|>0 ∧ (P ∧ Valid)), where Valid is exactly the assumed trajectory validity and P is the full package of the following clauses.
P retains quality Q and the assertion that every direction occurs before S.
For every k≤S, U_k is obtained from U⁰ by applying T_0,T_1,…,T_{k−1} in that order. For k=0 the composition is empty and gives U⁰.

For every k<S and cell c, let e=d_k, L=cellLine_ℓ(e,c), j=cellIndex_ℓ(e,c), and v=extract_{ℓ,g_k}(e,L,U_k). Then U_{k+1}(c)=v_j−(τ_k/V_c)[N_ℓ(e,L,τ_k,v,j+1)−N_ℓ(e,L,τ_k,v,j)], where V_c is the cell volume.
For every k<S, Σ_c V_c U_{k+1}(c)=Σ_c V_c U_k(c)−τ_k Σ_c[R_k(d_k,τ_k,U_k,rightFace(d_k,c))−R_k(d_k,τ_k,U_k,leftFace(d_k,c))]. This is an equality of vectors in V.

For every k<S, cell c, and states u,w:Cell_ℓ→V, if u(c′)=w(c′) for every cell c′ whose d_k-line equals that of c, then T_{ℓ,g_k,d_k,τ_k}u(c)=T_{ℓ,g_k,d_k,τ_k}w(c). The same fixed ghost field is used on both sides.

For every direction e, field q, real order p, certificate with constant C and threshold N, level n≥N, and t∈(0,H], take any boundary field b and current state u such that u is admitted using b and P_n q(0) is admitted using the reference ghosts b^q_n. For all real A,E,G, if the original level-n method is StableAt(e,t,A), every cell satisfies ||u(c)−P_n q(0)(c)||∞≤E, and every missing index j on every occupied e-line satisfies ||b(e,L,j)−b^q_n(e,L,j)||∞≤G, then every cell satisfies ||T_{n,b,e,t}u(c)−P_n q(t)(c)||∞≤A max(E,G)+C t h_n^p.

For arbitrary fields q_k, real sequences a_k,l_k,s_k, real B₀ and real η_k(c), assume for each k<S: τ_k>0; q_k is ReferenceOn(d_k,0,τ_k); U_k and c↦M_ℓ(q_k,c,0) are both admitted by the kth ghost-modified method; that method is StableAt(d_k,τ_k,a_k); the norm of its net flux discrepancy against q_k on [0,τ_k] is at most η_k(c) for every c; (τ_k/V_c)η_k(c)≤l_k; and ||M_ℓ(q_k,c,τ_k)−M_ℓ(q_{k+1},c,0)||∞≤s_k. Also assume ||U⁰(c)−M_ℓ(q_0,c,0)||∞≤B₀ for every c. Then for every k≤S and cell c, ||U_k(c)−M_ℓ(q_k,c,0)||∞≤B_k, where B_{k+1}=a_k B_k+l_k+s_k.

For any axes, cell positions i(c), directional face positions z(e,f), and directional fluxes f_e satisfying the Cartesian representation predicate at level ℓ, all of the following hold together: V_c=∏_e width_e(i(c)_e) for every cell; for every field q, cell c and real t, M_ℓ(q,c,t) equals its product-Lebesgue normalized integral over the half-open box at i(c); for every q:R→R→V, direction e, face f and real t, the physical face flux of (x,s)↦q(x_e,s) equals [∏_{a≠e}width_a(z(e,f)_a)] f_e(q(left_e(z(e,f)_e),t)); and whenever q satisfies the one-dimensional integral conservation law for f_e, every cell and real s,t satisfy V_c[M_ℓ(q∘coordinate_e,c,t)−M_ℓ(q∘coordinate_e,c,s)]=∫_s^t[physicalFlux_left(r)−physicalFlux_right(r)]dr.
mathematical_definitions: A level-n partition has a nonempty finite cell type, measurable pairwise-disjoint cell regions C_{n,c}, and domain exactly their union. The data's spatial measure μ_n assigns every cell a positive finite measure. V_{n,c}=μ_n(C_{n,c}) as a real number, and M_n(q,c,t)=V_{n,c}^{−1}∫_{C_{n,c}}q(x,t)dμ_n. All vector integrals are Bochner integrals.

Each direction and cell has designated left and right faces. A face has a measure on FacePoint, a map to spatial points, and a state-dependent normal flux. The maps for each incident face lie in the closure of the cell region almost everywhere. Physical face flux is the integral of the normal flux evaluated at the mapped physical state.

At every admissible state, each pointwise normal flux has an ambient real Fréchet derivative whose m×m standard-coordinate matrix admits a real eigenbasis: there exist λ_i∈R and a basis b_i of V with J b_i=λ_i b_i. These witnesses may depend on the direction, face, face parameter and state.

The family supplies these data, line coordinates and methods at every natural level. It has a common measure μ=μ_n, common nonempty directional state sets States_e equal to the data's admissible sets, a physical flux F(x,v,e), and normal coefficients ν(n,e,f,p,a) such that normalFlux(n,e,f,p,v)=Σ_a ν(n,e,f,p,a)F(facePoint(n,e,f,p),v,a). No unit-length condition on ν is stated.

There are spatial sets target⊆region with nonempty interior(target). Every cell region is contained in region and is bounded; every target point belongs to some cell at each level. h_n is exactly the maximum cell diameter in the maximum-coordinate metric, h_n>0, and h_n→0. The common horizon H is strictly positive. Every boundary region B_{n,e,L,j} is measurable, has positive finite μ-measure, and lies in region.

Coordinates assign a line and integer index to every cell and directional face. Lookup(e,cellLine(e,c),cellIndex(e,c))=some c, and lookup(e,L,j)=some c implies cellLine(e,c)=L and cellIndex(e,c)=j. The left and right faces of c share its line and have indices j and j+1. Replacing ghosts changes none of these assignments.

extract_b(e,L,u)_j=u(c) if lookup(e,L,j)=some c, and b(e,L,j) otherwise. The method supplies an arbitrary sequence flux N(e,L,t,v,j) and arbitrary predicate admitted(e,L,t,v). Global admission means that predicate holds on the extracted sequence for every cell's directional line.

R_{n,b}(e,t,u,f)=N_n(e,faceLine(e,f),t,extract_b(e,faceLine(e,f),u),faceIndex(e,f)). T_{n,b,e,t}u(c)=u(c)−(t/V_{n,c})[R_{n,b}(e,t,u,rightFace(e,c))−R_{n,b}(e,t,u,leftFace(e,c))]. Write T_k=T_{ℓ,g_k,d_k,τ_k}, U_0=U⁰ and U_{k+1}=T_k U_k. The auxiliary line formula uses volume one at absent lookup indices.
StableAt(e,t,A) means: for every cell c, any two sequences v,w admitted on its e-line, and every E≥0 satisfying ||v_j−w_j||∞≤E for all j∈Z, the line updates at c's index differ by at most A E.

Var(n,e,L,b,u) is the finite sum over cells c on line L, with j=cellIndex(e,c), of ||u(c)−extract_b(e,L,u)_{j−1}||∞, plus ||extract_b(e,L,u)_{j+1}−u(c)||∞ if lookup(e,L,j+1)=none. Cells off L contribute zero.

ReferenceOn(e,q,s,t) requires, at every time in [min(s,t),max(s,t)], integrability of q on each cell, integrability of the normal-flux integrands on each incident face, and membership q(x,r)∈States_e for every x in the partition domain. For every two times u,v in that interval it also requires temporal integrability of both incident physical face fluxes and V_c[M(q,c,v)−M(q,c,u)]=∫_u^v[physicalFlux_left(r)−physicalFlux_right(r)]dr for every cell.

A smooth reference q in direction e is infinitely differentiable within closure(region)×[0,H], is ReferenceOn(e,q,0,H) at every level, and has q(·,0) integrable on every boundary region in direction e. Precisely, at each point of that space-time set and every finite derivative order r, a relative neighborhood supports a continuous derivative tower through r. The order is embedded ENat infinity, not the additional outer top that requires analytic coefficients.

P_n q(t)(c)=M_n(q,c,t). Reference ghosts are b^q_n(e,L,j)=μ(B_{n,e,L,j})^{−1}∫_{B_{n,e,L,j}}q(x,0)dμ. A certificate for (e,q,p) consists of C≥0 and N∈N, an admitted reference duration t∈(0,H] for every n≥N, and, for every such n and every admitted reference duration in that interval, ||T_{n,b^q_n,e,t}(P_n q(0))(c)−P_n q(t)(c)||∞≤C t h_n^p for all cells.

For a rule R, current u, reference q and times s,t, the net flux discrepancy at c is [R(e,t−s,u,leftFace)−(t−s)^{−1}∫_s^t physicalFlux_left(r)dr]−[R(e,t−s,u,rightFace)−(t−s)^{−1}∫_s^t physicalFlux_right(r)dr]. The accumulated-error conclusion evaluates this at s=0,t=τ_k and u(c)=M_ℓ(q_k,c,0), using the same kth ghost-modified rule.

An axis consists of left_j<right_j for every j∈Z and right_{j−1}=left_j. Its width is right_j−left_j. A Cartesian cell box is ∏_e[left_e(i_e),right_e(i_e)); its volume is the product of widths. The transverse face box omits e, and its insertion map fixes coordinate e to left_e(z_e).

The Cartesian representation predicate requires: the left face position is i(c); the right face position is i(c) with its e-coordinate increased by one; μ_ℓ restricted to C_{ℓ,c} equals product Lebesgue measure restricted to the corresponding box; every face-point map is almost-everywhere measurable; its pushforward face measure equals the pushforward of transverse-box Lebesgue measure under the insertion map; and almost everywhere on each face, normalFlux(e,f,p,v)=f_e(v) simultaneously for every v∈V.

The one-dimensional integral conservation law for q and f requires q(·,t) integrable on every real spatial interval for every t, f(q(x,·)) integrable on every real time interval for every x, and ∫_a^b q(x,t)dx−∫_a^b q(x,s)dx=∫_s^t[f(q(a,r))−f(q(b,r))]dr for all real a,b,s,t.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive number of state components and nonempty finite set of directions, every family satisfying the specified geometric and physical structure and the assumed family-wide quality property, and every fixed-level finite trajectory whose schedule visits every direction and whose actual steps have positive durations at most the horizon and satisfy admission, the positivity assumptions and trajectory validity hold together with a package of exact composition, directional line-update, summed mass-balance and line-locality identities. The package also contains a one-step perturbation-and-accuracy estimate conditional on a supplied accuracy certificate, admission and stability; an accumulated-error estimate conditional on physical reference balances, stability and defect bounds; and Cartesian volume, mean, face-flux and one-dimensional balance identities conditional on a Cartesian representation. It does not construct a family, prove its quality from a concrete scheme, or assert unconditional convergence.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Empty directions and zero state dimension are explicitly excluded. The coverage hypothesis forces S≥|D| and in particular S>0. Cell types are nonempty and finite, so cellwise conditions and maxima are not vacuous through empty cells.
Existence of a family with all the stated geometric, physical and quality properties is not asserted. The theorem is conditional on such a family and on validity of the supplied trajectory.

Quality is an assumption and is retained in the conclusion. In particular, the order-greater-than-one certificate property and variation estimate are not newly established from numerical-flux formulas.

For a direction with no smooth references, its universal certificate requirement can be vacuous. The packet does not separately assert existence of a smooth reference. A supplied certificate does prevent complete absence of admitted reference steps at all sufficiently fine levels.

The general admitted predicate is arbitrary. Global admission alone is not definitionally a state-set membership condition or a specific CFL inequality. Quality guarantees some admitted duration for state-compatible data, not validity of every prescribed duration or automatic validity of the given schedule.

The schedule may repeat directions and has no prescribed cyclic order. Durations may vary by step. Only each duration is bounded by H; their sum is not required to be at most H, and no common physical-time grid is encoded.
The numerical flux can depend on the entire integer sequence. Line locality does not imply a finite stencil, nearest-neighbor dependence, or locality with respect to changes in the ghost field.

The mass identity retains a sum of outgoing-minus-incoming numerical face fluxes. It does not assert that this sum vanishes, that total mass is constant, or that boundary conditions are periodic or closed.

Stability constants are hypotheses of conditional error statements. The theorem does not provide them or a uniform bound on them. The one-step perturbation clause quantifies over arbitrary real E and G without separate nonnegativity hypotheses; occupied cells force E≥0 when its cell bound holds, but a ghost-error antecedent may be vacuous if no relevant missing indices exist.

The certificate-based perturbation clause allows any real p for which a certificate is supplied. Only the quality property's existence assertion requires p>1. Constants and thresholds may depend on the reference; there is no uniform certificate over all smooth references.

The accumulated-error clause compares a sequence of separate fields at local time zero and local time τ_k. Their mismatch is bounded by a supplied splitting defect. It does not identify them with one common physical solution at cumulative times, bound defects asymptotically, or show the recurrence tends to zero.

The family spatial measure is arbitrary subject to its constraints. Lebesgue box geometry is only asserted under the additional Cartesian representation predicate, whose implication may be vacuous if no such representation exists.
Axis intervals need not have uniform widths or cover the entire real line. General family cells need not be Cartesian, and normal coefficients are not required to form unit normals.

Real vector norms and spatial mesh diameters use maximum-coordinate norms. The derivative eigenbasis condition imposes real diagonalizability, not distinct eigenvalues, a uniform eigenbasis condition number, or a specified characteristic-speed bound.

Cell and boundary averaging denominators are positive and finite by the family structure. General integral expressions remain totalized; unconditional mean and Cartesian identities do not themselves add integrability assumptions. ReferenceOn and smooth-reference definitions explicitly supply integrability where stated.

Face-map placement and Cartesian normal-flux agreement are almost-everywhere assertions. The Cartesian flux agreement quantifies over all states inside the almost-everywhere predicate, giving a common exceptional null set for those states.

The selected smoothness order is infinite differentiability within a closed space-time set. It is not the separate analytic branch and does not require an explicitly supplied smooth extension to an open neighborhood.
